name: cbio-blca-iatlas-imvigor210-2017
alternateName: Metastatic Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma (IMvigor210 Phase II Trial, ESMO Open. 2024) - iAtlas Harmonized
description: Whole-exome sequencing and neoantigen landscape analysis of 347 metastatic bladder urothelial carcinomas and their matched normals, generated from a phase II trial of atezolizumab monotherapy in cisplatin-ineligible and platinum-pretreated patients. The reprocessing of raw sequencing data is coordinated by CRI iAtlas.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
